translations.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
translations.bsb: In those days Jesus went out to the mountain to pray, and He spent the night in prayer to God.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in these days, that he went out into the mountain to pray; and he continued all night in prayer to God.
